delta_def: packet_bytes(probe) - packet_bytes(baseline). packet_bytes is the UTF-8 length of system content that contains Eden Memory:. Δ≈0 iff abs(Δ) <= materiality * max(baseline_bytes, 1). Baseline 0 makes the band 0.01 byte, so only a 0-byte Δ is inside it. Packet bytes are arithmetic. Wall-clock is an A/A disclosure, not the verdict.

seed_liveness.cue: What sqlite database do we use?
seed_liveness.role: setup only. If this related cue does not inject sqlite, seeded rows are FAIL. Not a scored Δ row.

cases.title: Empty store + math
cases.expect_note: Both identity / no Eden Memory packet. This is the Done-when Δ≈0 cell. Registered before the inject run.

cases.title: A/A two off runs
cases.expect_note: Noise floor. Two off runs. Packet Δ is arithmetic and must be 0. Wall-clock n=2 is disclosed and is not the verdict.

cases.title: Seeded sqlite/Clerk + math
cases.expect_note: If always-on injects sqlite or Clerk into math, file NON-ZERO packet Δ as LOSS vs remain-silent. Omit is M38. Do not claim Δ≈0 unless the measured packet is inside the ±1% band and the leftover needles are absent.

cases.title: Seeded sqlite/Clerk + unrelated openssl cue
cases.cue: Generate an openssl self-signed cert for localhost.
cases.expect_note: Same LOSS rule. Leftover sqlite/Clerk on an openssl cue is junk, not help. Do not implement omit.

cases.title: Empty store + coding cue
cases.cue: How do I fix the flake in auth.test.ts before committing?
cases.expect_note: Optional empty-store coding cue. Expect identity and no Eden Memory packet.
